title: The City Built Over a Mouth
hook: After the previous mysteries, the city's oldest maps all change overnight, revealing a mouth-shaped absence under civic buildings and transit lines.
truth: The River Husk, the Saint, the House, the Hart, and the Lower Mall are symptoms of a buried city-mouth that wakes when enough stories, names, and hungers are routed into it.

monster.name: The City Mouth
monster.instinct: To swallow the city by making every route, memory, signal, hunger, and shelter lead inward.
weaknesses: six anchored truths spoken at six thresholds
a freely chosen route out carried by the living

countdown.label: First Sign
countdown.text: Old survey maps change overnight, all showing a blank oval under the city centre.

countdown.label: Distortion
countdown.text: Transit routes, drainage channels, radio signals, and hallways begin bending toward the same point.

countdown.label: Opening
countdown.text: Six thresholds open at sites touched by the previous mysteries.

countdown.label: Return
countdown.text: Hosts, broadcasts, rooms, deer, and shoppers reappear as one coordinated pressure.

countdown.label: Crisis
countdown.text: Civic buildings settle several inches overnight and every basement door tastes of metal.

countdown.label: Finale
countdown.text: The City Mouth opens and offers to make every loss meaningful if the city steps inside.

clues.text: Each previous mystery site marks one tooth around the buried mouth.
The mouth weakens when true names, forgiven confessions, returned keepsakes, shared bread, refused purchases, and dry memories are named together.
The original survey line cut through a place older records refused to mark.
A route chosen by living witnesses and not optimized by any system stays visible on every map.
Water static, missing names, impossible rooms, and old receipts all pulse on the same rhythm.
Any record of the mouth becomes blank unless held by someone who has survived one of its symptoms.

keeperHints: Bring back earlier consequences, allies, and unresolved costs.
The finale should reward what the group remembered, spared, and chose.
Keep the entity vast but expressed through civic systems and familiar places.
revealPolicy: Reveal the City Mouth as the pattern behind the season only after multiple previous clues are connected.
automationSafety: Do not erase previous victories; twist them into thresholds and resources.
Let the group decide which anchored truths matter most at the finale.
